content: वैदर्भः [विदर्भ-अण्] .²1 A king of Vidarbha. .²2 A gum-boil. .{@-र्भम्@} Crafty, ambiguous speech. .{@-र्भी@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Damayantī; धन्यासि वैदर्भि गुणैरुदारैः <ls>N. 3. 116</ls>. .²2 Of Rukmiṇī. .²3 A particular style of composition; thus defined in <ls>S. D.</ls>:-- माधुर्यव्यञ्जकैर्वर्णै रचना ललितात्मिका . अवृत्तिरल्पवृत्तिर्वा वैदर्भी रीतिरिष्यते .. <ls n="S. D.">626</ls>. Daṇḍin very minutely distinguishes this style from the {%Gaudiya%}; see <ls>Kāv. 1. 41-53</ls>. Alaṃkāraśekhara quotes <ls>Ku. 5. 4</ls> as an illustration. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of the wife of Agastya.
